note: Bendigo and Adelaide Bank reports under APRA's APS 330, which has no KM1 template. Neither LCR nor NSFR was reported in Australia at these dates, and APS 330 required no leverage ratio. A four-page quarterly report from before Bendigo adopted the tabular APS 330 layout. It lists risk-weighted assets by portfolio but prints no total RWA row, so RWA is left out rather than summed from the components, and it publishes only two ratios - 'Total and Tier 1 capital ratio for the consolidated group' - with no CET1 ratio at this early point in the Basel III transition. The table is headed 'Capital Adequacy as at March 31st 2013' and the announcement is dated 28 May 2013.
